performance.workload: 1kg_chr22_5_samples.vds: 4077 reference rows, 81 variant rows, 5 samples; plan to_dense_mt and collect localized results
performance.limitations: Exploratory shared-host smoke timing, not a controlled throughput benchmark. Different native storage formats for equivalent independently extracted fixture values. Both engines initialized before timings; native read plan constructed before timings. No claim of faster performance.

correctness.golden: Fresh independent pinned-Hail dense output; field names/types, globals, columns, and all 81 row values match, with NaNs equal. Entry field order is deliberately not compared because Hail uses Python set iteration.
correctness.limits: Not a full upstream VDS suite pass; advanced methods and workflow intentionally absent. No performance acceptance.
